CHIEF COMPLAINT
Followup of chronic problems

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Bruce is a 60-year-old male with past medical history significant for depression, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension presenting for followup of his chronic conditions. Patient reports it has been a "crazy year and a half" with anxiety and pressure related to holiday preparations wearing on him. He had a nice Thanksgiving holiday seeing family after about two years but found it stressful with a lot of work. He is planning a vacation to somewhere nice and warm for the new year.

Regarding depression: Patient reports that over the summer he started going for long walks outside every morning when the weather was nice, which he found helpful. On weekends this encouraged him to do yard work and be active with sun exposure. However, with seasonal changes and cold weather, he has not been able to continue this and needs to find something new. Patient denies wanting to try medications at this time and is interested in exploring alternative options including therapy. He denies any suicidal or homicidal ideation.

Regarding diabetes: Patient reports getting through Halloween okay but did not stick to diet during Thanksgiving week. States it is better now and he has been trying to monitor it. Currently taking metformin. He acknowledges his hemoglobin A1c is elevated.

Regarding hypertension: Patient purchased a blood pressure cuff as recommended. Reports blood pressures have been running "pretty moderate" with nothing out of the ordinary. No portal notes submitted. Currently taking lisinopril with no problems.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient denies chest pain, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, blood in stool, or weight loss.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Depression
Type 2 diabetes
Hypertension

MEDICATIONS
Metformin (for diabetes)
Lisinopril (for hypertension)

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient enjoys outdoor walks and yard work. Planning vacation. Recently attended Thanksgiving gathering with family.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital signs: Blood pressure good. No carotid bruits on neck exam. Heart exam: slight 2/6 systolic ejection murmur heard at left base (previously noted). Lungs: clear bilaterally. Extremities: 1+ non-pitting edema bilaterally in lower extremities.

RESULTS
EKG: No evidence of concerning findings.
Hemoglobin A1c: 8 (elevated; goal <6)

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Depression: Refer to psychiatry for talk therapy, not for medications.

Type 2 Diabetes: Increase metformin to 1000 mg twice daily. Order hemoglobin A1c in the next couple months. Order lipid panel.

Hypertension: Keep lisinopril at 20 mg daily. Order echocardiogram to recheck heart murmur.
